name: RBSE Class 10 NotebookLM Prompt & Content Research Library

usage.instruction: Upload your official RBSE / NCERT Class 10 textbooks or study guides to NotebookLM. Run these prompts to extract verified study packs, PYQs, and predicted questions, then import the exported JSON via BoardReady Founder Workspace (/content-review).
recommended_workflow: 1. Select target subject and chapter in NotebookLM.
2. Run prompt 'core-01' for Chapter Revision Notes.
3. Run prompt 'core-02' for 20 Board PYQs with Model Answers.
4. Run prompt 'core-03' for 20 AI-Predicted Board Questions.
6. Download Content Pack JSON and import in BoardReady app.

prompts.title: Comprehensive Chapter Study Notes & Formula Sheet
prompts.prompt:
Using the uploaded RBSE Class 10 [SUBJECT] sources, generate an exhaustive, exam-oriented study guide for Chapter '[CHAPTER NAME]' (Board Weightage: [WEIGHTAGE%]).

Include the following sections:
1. Chapter Overview & Board Exam Significance
2. Key Definitions, Concepts & Fundamental Laws
3. Formulas, Mathematical Derivations & Ray Diagrams (if applicable)
4. Step-by-Step Solved Board Examples
5. Top 5 Common Student Mistakes / Exam Traps
6. 1-Page Exam Day Summary Sheet
7. Source References & Page Citations

Rules:
- Maintain extreme technical accuracy according to the latest RBSE Class 10 marking scheme.
- Format formulas clearly with standard variables.
- Output in clean JSON matching BoardReady Content Pack schema.

prompts.title: 20 Verified Previous Year Board Questions (PYQs)
prompts.prompt:
Extract 20 verified Previous Year Questions (PYQs) from 2019 to 2025 for RBSE Class 10 [SUBJECT] chapter '[CHAPTER NAME]'.

For each question provide:
1. Question ID & Exam Year
2. Exact Question Text
3. Marks Weightage (1, 2, 3, or 5 marks)
4. Chapter/Topic Name
5. Step-by-Step Model Answer matching RBSE marking scheme
6. Repeat Frequency & High-Priority Tagging
7. Source Citation

If exact year is unverified, label as 'Year Unverified'. Do not fabricate fake questions.

prompts.title: 20 AI-Predicted Board Questions for 2026
prompts.prompt:
Based on historical RBSE Class 10 exam patterns, repetition frequency, and core curriculum weightage, generate 20 PREDICTED Board Exam Questions for '[CHAPTER NAME]' in [SUBJECT].

For each question provide:
1. Prediction ID
2. Predicted Question Text
3. Marks Weightage
4. Probability Rating: 🔥 High Probability / ⚡ Must Prepare / 🎯 Practice
5. Prediction Rationale (e.g., 'Repeated every 2 years', 'Core 5-mark theorem')
6. Model Answer Outline with Key Technical Keywords
7. Related Past-Year Question Reference

prompts.title: 20 Board-Oriented Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
prompts.prompt:
Create 20 high-quality MCQs for RBSE Class 10 [SUBJECT] chapter '[CHAPTER NAME]'.

Distribution:
- 5 Factual & Definition Questions
- 5 Conceptual & Formula Application Questions
- 5 Diagram / Reaction / Text-based Questions
- 5 Common Trap & Tricky Questions

For each MCQ provide: Question, 4 Options (A, B, C, D), Correct Option Index, and Detailed Step-by-Step Explanation.
